settings.partReuse.hint: When enabled, interchangeable part positions can be grouped on the Part Reuse page. When picking textures in the package properties, textures of other parts in the same group become candidates and are marked as Multi-Source. Disabling the feature keeps existing groups.
settings.partReuse.notice:
Part Reuse is for part positions that are named differently but whose textures are interchangeable. Once grouped, those parts can pick each other's textures in the package properties.

You declare the equivalence; the program does not check that the textures actually match, and a wrong grouping produces wrong textures.

Choose '{0}': enable and stop asking; choose '{1}': keep it off for now and ask again next time.

pkg.editor.title: Skin Package Properties
pkg.editor.partsHint:
Parts with the same position identifier count as the same part position. You can pick textures of the same position from other packages of the same vehicle to fill this package; parts set to Not Set are not output and the game uses its default texture.

Candidates also include textures of the same position from other vehicles, marked as Cross-Vehicle; with Part Reuse enabled, textures of other parts in the same group are included too, marked as Multi-Source.

Tags next to part names are inferred from naming conventions and are for reference only.
pkg.editor.partNone: None, this part is not output
pkg.editor.extraBlk.hint: Blocks that cannot be attributed, meaning those without a to, plus your free-form content, are emitted at the end of the blk file. Write order does not affect game load order.
pkg.editor.blkEditor.title: Edit blk Blocks · {0}
pkg.editor.blkEditor.hint: Only the raw text of these blocks changes: confirming writes them back to the property page, and the property page's OK saves them to disk. Blocks marked Changed are the ones you edited; untouched blocks stay byte-identical to the source blk.
pkg.editor.blkEditor.empty: This position has no blocks yet. Pick a texture for it in the package editor and a basic block is added automatically.
pkg.editor.mode.notice:
You are changing how a part is written. Please confirm:

• replace_tex: replaces the part's original texture; used by most parts.
• set_tex: sets the main camouflage texture; normally only for hull or airframe.

A wrong choice does not cause game errors, but the skin may not work or may look wrong.

Choose '{0}': apply this time and stop asking; choose '{1}': change nothing now and ask again next time.
